review.images: Aldar’s Mamsha Gardens launch identifies the buildings, landscaped spaces and residence and amenity scenes. The wider district aerial is used for context only. The related Mamsha Palm gallery was kept separate.
review.location: The launch aerial shows the surrounding Saadiyat beachfront. Property Finder’s Mamsha Gardens masterplan section states the three travel estimates. They are reported by the portal and entrance coordinates remain unverified.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all eleven Golden Dome PDF pages and all 15 Property Finder drawings. Retained nine PDF pages and six labelled portal drawings. The portal versions replace the duplicated Type 1 examples on PDF pages 1 and 8. Excluded the lower-resolution unlabelled portal renders and a repeated image. The 213 m² average and 216 m² GSA refer to two differently oriented Type 3 examples. The separate previously researched PDF displays a confidentiality notice and is not reproduced.

unavailable: Verified individual building entrance coordinates, signed unit areas, and complete published drawings for unlabelled listing variants.
